entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Independence and Republic, a transformative movement in Malta (1945–1979). Emerged from Operation Pedestal relief convoy reaches besieged Malta and King George VI awards the George Cross to the island of Malta for heroism. Catalyzed Malta joins the European Union.
